span.p:
Key design points:
- Each region has its own cache cluster (local reads, low latency)
- Each region has its own DB replica (local loader, no cross-region queries)
- Cross-region replication is async (eventual consistency)
- Writes go to the primary region and replicate to replicas
- Cache invalidation on write: broadcast to all regions
